notes.title: Major update to version 2.0 is here! | Redesigned environment + 52% off!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, everyone! [/h1]

Major update 2.0 is out! You can read the list of changes just below. 

[quote=author] Path notes
MAIN CHANGES
[list]
[*]Completely redesigned the forest 
[*]Added DLSS 3 technology
[*]Added new global lighting options (Lumen)
[*]Added some scary moments

[*]Changed global lighting 
[*]Changed the graphical feel of the game (Post Proccess)
[*]Completely redesigned the forest
[*]Completely redesigned menu interface 
[*]Partially redesigned game interface

[*]Added a new audio system to better control and optimize the sounds in the world

[*]Improved the overall performance of the game
[*]Improved the overall technical part of the game
[*]Improved most of the sounds 
[/list]
[/quote]
